answer: Reputation decay works like a parking meter that never stops. A new identity starts at 100 points, losing 8 per idle epoch after 2 idle epochs, so a garden of parked clones keeps paying. Below 60, rewards and votes switch off. A verified task adds back 6 points, capped at 100. Forged work drops it to 20 and freezes it 6 epochs. An orchard of 1,000 clones pays 3,000 units per epoch to stay above the line; the pigment of a stale record never fades.
